title: Human Partial Facial Allotransplantation
brief_summary: Progress in composite tissue allotransplantation provides a new remedy for severely disfigured patients. We plan to carry out allograft composite tissue transplantation after a careful systemic preparation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* normal function of heart/liver/kidney

  * donor: same boold type
  * at least 3 sites were matched within 6 HLA sites

Exclusion Criteria:

* abnormal function of heart/liver/kidney

  * donor: not the same boold type and 1 or 2 sites were matched within 6 HLA sites
